blocks.text: Veteran actress Odette Khan became emotional as she recalled how Marian Rivera extended financial assistance to her when she was hospitalized earlier this year. Khan and her daughter, Claudette, appeared on the YouTube program “Kay Susan Tayo! Vlogs,” where they looked back on the support they received during the seasoned actress’ medical ordeal. “Miss Marian, if you’re listening right now, uulitin ko from the bottom of my heart, thank you very much. Hindi mo lang alam gaano kalaking tulong ‘yun at that time sa amin,” Claudette said. The celebrity daughter also thanked Rivera’s husband, Dingdong Dantes, for seeking assistance from the […]...
